title: Eleven People and One Chapel
subtitle: 宗教信仰 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 宗教信仰（历史社会与文化·宗教与信仰）
meta: 主题语境：宗教信仰（历史社会与文化·宗教与信仰）　|　核心词汇：spirit　|　正文 292 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 spirit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There were eleven of us at the service in 1974 and four in 2003, and my grandmother said the ① spirit of a chapel has nothing to do with how many people are in it, and everything to do with whether they speak to each other afterwards, and that the spirit is not in the building at all.

She did not believe in ② spirits and she did believe in something, and she never said what. What she believed in, as far as I could tell, was the ③ spirit of the building, which she cleaned for thirty-one years and which she said was better company than most of the congregation.

In her last year she was in ④ good spirits almost every morning and in terrible ones by evening, in no spirits at all by eleven, which the doctor said was normal and which my mother said was not, and which my grandmother said was none of their business.
She never touched ⑤ spirits, not even at a wedding, and she said the ⑥ spirit of a rule and the letter of it are two different things, and that a chapel should be judged by the first.

She died in 1996 and I did not go, which I have regretted for thirty-one years. I was there ⑦ in spirit, as people say, which my mother called the laziest phrase in the language and which I have not used since. What my grandmother had, and I have not, was ⑧ spirit in the oldest sense: the thing that keeps eleven people coming to a cold building on a Tuesday. My father said she had more ⑨ spirit in her little finger than the rest of us had between us, and that the ⑩ spirit of the place went with her in 1996.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n.[pl.] 情绪；心境（in good / low spirits）
C. n. 灵魂；鬼魂；幽灵
D. n. 勇气；志气；骨气
E. n.[pl.] 烈酒；酒精饮料
F. n. 集体精神；团队精神（community spirit）
G. 固定搭配：in spirit 在心里；精神上（到场）
H. n. 精神实质；宗旨（the spirit of the law）

items.q: She did not believe in spirits
was spirit in the oldest sense
she had more spirit in her little finger
the spirit of the place went with her

answers.why: the spirit of ... 意为“……的集体精神”，一座小教堂的团体精神跟里面有多少人无关。
spirits 复数意为“鬼魂、灵魂”，她不信鬼魂，却信某种东西，只是从不说是什么。
the spirit of ... 意为“……的精神（气质）”，她信的是那座建筑的精神，她为它打扫了三十一年。
in good spirits 意为“情绪好、心情好”，她最后一年几乎每天早上心情都很好。
spirits 复数意为“烈酒”，她从不沾烈酒，连婚礼上也不。
the spirit of a rule / law 意为“一条规矩的精神实质”，与它的字面相对。
in spirit 意为“精神上（到场）”，我说我在精神上到场了，母亲说那是语言里最懒的说法。
spirit 意为“精神”，最古老意义上的那种：让十一个人星期二还来一座冷房子里的东西。
spirit 意为“志气、骨气、勇气”，父亲说她一个小指头里的志气比我们所有人加起来还多。
the spirit of the place 意为“这个地方的精神／精气神”，1996 年随她一起走了。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我祖母说，一座小教堂的团体精神跟里面有多少人无关。（spirit）
她不信鬼魂，却信某种东西。（spirits）
她最后一年几乎每天早上心情都很好。（in good spirits）
她从不沾烈酒，连婚礼上也不。（spirits）
她说，一条规矩的精神实质和它的字面是两回事。（the spirit of）
我说我在精神上到场了，母亲说那是语言里最懒的说法。（in spirit）
answers: My grandmother said the spirit of a chapel has nothing to do with how many people are in it.
She did not believe in spirits and she did believe in something.
In her last year she was in good spirits almost every morning.
She never touched spirits, not even at a wedding.
She said the spirit of a rule and the letter of it are two different things.
I said I was there in spirit, and my mother called it the laziest phrase in the language.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 spirit 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My grandmother said the spirit of a chapel has nothing to do with how many people are in it.
She did not believe in spirits, but she believed in the spirit of the building she cleaned for thirty-one years.
In her last year she was in good spirits every morning and in terrible ones by evening.
She never touched spirits, and she said the spirit of a rule and the letter of it are two different things.
I was at her funeral in spirit, which my mother called the laziest phrase in the language.
She had more spirit in her little finger than the rest of us, and the spirit of the place went with her in 1996.
